objective: Close the protocol-specific SOTA gaps in this order: opening consumer, room identity/count, wall precision/junction, edge/GED, furniture, matched external evidence, RPLAN/test freeze, and editing. Do not touch chips/FloorSet.

target_contract.kind: internal strong CVPR target gates, not claims about unmatched external leaderboards
target_contract.stability: Five seeds with case-paired CI; do not pool heterogeneous protocols.

negative.lesson: Never mix oracle, predicted, generation, complete CAD, and editing rows.
Global scale does not replace typed spatial state.
Small connector gain did not scale; cache candidates first.
Count can improve while identity collapses.
Count gain traded away Room/support and holdout quality.

negative.arm: Selective support deletion as complete CAD
negative.lesson: Room-only gains must be consumed during owner/wall learning.
Walls need room boundaries; openings need named host walls.

rules: Every head has a typed output and canonical consumer.
No stage reads a future stage tensor.
Disabled branches exactly reproduce the parent checkpoint.
Every promoted arm stores seed, split, parameters, updates, NFE, latency, and SHA-256.

tasks.title: Opening interval five-seed closure
actions: Finish the five seed-matched interval heads currently training with 384 calibration and 107 offset-384 holdout cases.
For each seed, run full val491 with and without the opening detector using identical rooms/walls.
Compare Opening F1 and non-opening metrics with case-paired bootstrap; compare GED only on the intersection of exact cases.
Require the opening gain and structural non-regression to hold on at least four of five seeds.
Connect the accepted detector to CadStageRuntime as an opening-only replacement.

gate.primary: Opening F1 CI above zero on full val and holdout.
gate.non_regression: Room, wall, Node, Edge, exact-GED, validity, and watertightness do not regress.

tasks.failure_response: Return to joint selected-wall host supervision.

tasks.title: Room identity and count root-cause repair
actions: Decompose current predicted-control errors into missing rooms, duplicate fragments, wrong merges, class swaps, and count over-prediction by room-count/complexity bins.
Measure oracle support and oracle identity ceilings separately to decide whether support, existence, or identity is the first failing stage.
Run matched 256/64 arms: static, adaptive reference query, dynamic loss weights, and both; all branches initialize from the same query checkpoint.
Require joint Room IoU, instance F1, count MAE, support IoU, and type-accuracy gains on calibration64 and offset-128 holdout.
If the winning mechanism passes, promote to 1024/256 two seeds before full validation.

gate.primary: Room IoU, instance F1, and count MAE improve together on both calibration and holdout.
gate.support: Support IoU and type accuracy do not regress.
gate.mechanism: Adaptive references vary by image; dynamic loss scales stay bounded; disabled branch is identical.

tasks.failure_response: If adaptive branches fail, diagnose reference collapse, class assignment, and count supervision before adding capacity.

tasks.title: Five-seed room identity promotion
actions: Run the winning identity arm on full training data with 384 calibration and 107 offset-384 holdout.
Run five seeds; do not pool calibration and holdout rows.
Evaluate full val491 and the complete wall/opening plan for every seed.
Report count, Room IoU, F1, type accuracy, support, and structural metrics by room-count and edit-complexity bins.

gate.stability: Primary gains hold on at least four of five seeds; support/legality hold on five.
gate.quality: Room IoU >= 0.60, instance F1 >= 0.70, count MAE <= 2.5 as the first staged target; continue toward the final target contract.

tasks.failure_response: Return to the failing stage; do not hide instability with pooled means.

tasks.title: Wall precision and typed junction closure
actions: Build candidates from selected room boundaries and consume support probability before wall-candidate scoring.
Add typed junction incidence as a first-class wall state with a real endpoint-snapping consumer.
Test collinear consolidation, candidate pruning, and junction degree constraints as separate matched arms.
Measure wall precision, wall F1, dangling endpoints, junction F1/degree, opening F1, and Edge/GED.

gate.primary: Wall precision improves from 0.389 toward 0.75 and wall F1 from 0.475 toward 0.80.
gate.non_regression: Room, opening, Node, and Edge metrics do not regress.

tasks.failure_response: Return to candidate provenance or junction consumer; do not tune binary wall threshold.

tasks.title: Adjacency, Edge overlap, and GED closure
actions: Supervise room-pair adjacency on the selected owner graph rather than applying GED loss alone.
Use identity-preserving room nodes and host-wall/opening edges; reject duplicate room-type nodes.
Stratify errors by room count, room deletion, merged rooms, and boundary-crossing edits.
Report paired Node/Edge/GED deltas on the exact-evaluator intersection.

gate.edge: Edge overlap moves from 0.363 toward 0.65 with paired CI above zero.
gate.ged: GED moves from 10.30 toward 3.5 with a fixed evaluator and paired test.
gate.node: Node F1 remains >= 0.80 and improves toward 0.90.

tasks.failure_response: Return to room identity or owner adjacency; do not optimize an approximate GED surrogate without canonical-plan gain.

tasks.title: Room-conditioned vector furniture
actions: Reuse room-instance tokens and direct vector-primitive supervision for furniture.
Require explicit query-to-room assignment and containment in the canonical plan.
Evaluate furniture F1, type accuracy, containment, polygon validity, and out-of-boundary rate.

gate.non_regression: Room/wall/opening metrics remain within paired noise.

tasks.failure_response: Keep furniture outside the main SOTA claim until its canonical consumer passes.

tasks.title: Matched external and statistical evidence
actions: Freeze executable Raster2Seq, CE2EPlan, TLC-Plan, and any complete HouseMind replay row.
Match cases, preprocessing, evaluator, post-processing, parameters, sample exposure, NFE, latency, and peak memory.
Report paired bootstrap, Wilcoxon/effect size, exact-evaluator coverage, and unavailable rows explicitly.
Keep generation, reconstruction, predicted-control, oracle-control, and editing tables separate.

gate.claim: At least one protocol-primary metric improves with a paired interval excluding zero and no structural regression.

tasks.failure_response: Mark unavailable baselines unavailable; never fill with proxies.

tasks.title: RPLAN five-seed validation and frozen test
actions: Run the final architecture on five RPLAN seeds and the full validation split.
Freeze code, checkpoints, thresholds, baselines, and statistics.
Open the test exactly once and publish all outcomes.

gate.stability: All five seeds preserve quality and structural guards.
gate.reproducibility: Every test number maps to a frozen command and artifact.

tasks.failure_response: Keep test closed and return to validation.

tasks.title: Predicted-control and free-text editing
actions: Predict edit regions and typed actions without oracle controls.
Add text parsing, conflict handling, and abstention only after predicted controls stabilize.
Compare only against executable same-protocol editing rows.
tasks.failure_response: Disable free-text promotion if controls are unstable.

tasks.title: CVPR evidence freeze
actions: Run all non-chips tests, Ruff, 600-line checks, JSON validation, manifest and SHA-256 verification.
Map every reported number to its generator and source artifact.
Freeze environment lockfile, claim boundaries, protocol matrix, and deterministic archive.
Exclude chips/FloorSet artifacts.

gate.evidence: No orphan, stale, or cross-protocol metric.

tasks.failure_response: Remove the unsupported claim or repair the chain.

Deformable-DETR.use: adaptive reference points and learned sampling
